Thank you

messages.author: 5140016d70f6ba82
messages.subject: Re: unequal bins
parts:
Yes set the distance for the last bin to 75 and then under Data Filter
for an analysis, select the Intervals tab, check the box "Transform
distance data into intervals for analysis. Set 6 cutpoints and then
enter them as 0 10 20 30 40 50 100. Hope this is what you are looking for.

--jeff
